name: khepra-trust-os
description: The trust layer for autonomous AI agents. Records every agent action as a post-quantum-signed, content-addressed AI Evidence Object, computes live trust scores, issues portable Agent Passports, and proves determinism across transports via dual-anchor attestation.

transports.role: sovereign execution — customer-owned, air-gap-capable, no third party in the trust boundary
public catalog, traction metrics, third-party agent onboarding

tools.name: aeo_record
tools.summary: Seal one agent action as a signed, chained AI Evidence Object.

tools.name: aeo_verify
tools.summary: Verify one AEO: hash integrity + ML-DSA-65 signature + identity binding.

tools.name: ledger_replay
tools.summary: Forensic replay: re-verify an agent's full history genesis-to-tip.

tools.name: passport_issue
tools.summary: Issue a registrar-signed Agent Passport (earned by record).

tools.name: passport_verify
tools.summary: Verify a passport document and re-derive its claims against the ledger.

tools.name: dual_anchor
tools.summary: Dual-anchor determinism/drift proof across two transports.

tools.name: ledger_stats
tools.summary: Aggregate trust metrics for traction dashboards.
